title: VerificationCheckOutcome
description: Explicit outcome of one verification check

PASSED.description: The check ran and established its required fact

FAILED.description: The check ran and rejected its required fact

NOT_PERFORMED.description: The check was required or selected but did not run

UNSUPPORTED.description: The implementation cannot perform the selected check

ERROR.description: The check could not produce a fact because processing errored

NOT_APPLICABLE.description: The selected profile determined that the check does not apply
